Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have been an owner for over 20 yers. My previous Weber Spirit 500 was accidentally destroyed and I replaced it with the Weber E-210 which is the 2 burner model. I really like the placement of the control knobs on the front and the fact that it heats quickly. This new model gets to a much higher temperature than my old model. Also the burners are to the left and right rather than front and back.  This makes having a hot side and a cool side easier to control. The reversible grates is really nice as I like using the "flat" side for hamburgers, hotdogs, chicken, and pork cutlets and the "sharp" side for steaks. I also like the igniter system on this model.  The only change I would make is to move the utensil holders to the front of the shelves.  I have been very pleased with the performance of my Weber E-210.
Results.Title: Great Grill

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
